comment: The differential's permanent country set. Both runners read this file so the two halves cannot drift apart, and so a country cannot quietly leave the harness. The first eleven are the working set the merge battery used. ZMB, LBY and SRB were added by CC-6 (TEA-1403): all three used to diverge between the engines, and the harness could not see it, because a country that failed on one side was simply left out of the comparison. They stay whether they pass or fail.
